pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to the Universal Music Store (UVS) monorepo: what it is, its dual-database architecture (Medusa + Supabase), the apps and packages it contains, and how to navigate the wiki.

pages.title: Architecture & Data Ownership
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the two-database split (Medusa as commerce SoR, Supabase as platform/identity SoR), ADR decisions, data ownership rules, and how the apps and packages relate to each other.

pages.title: Getting Started & Environment Setup
pages.purpose: How to set up the local development environment: pnpm workspace, environment variables, Docker for Medusa, DevContainer, and the monorepo root env loader script.

pages.title: Storefront Application
pages.purpose: Overview of apps/storefront — the Next.js 15 customer-facing app. Links to child pages covering routing, checkout, cart, CMS rendering, and observability.

pages.title: Storefront Routing & Pages
pages.purpose: The Next.js App Router structure for the storefront: public routes (shop, PDP, cart, checkout, account, blog, etc.), SEO sitemap generation, and the OnboardingGuard.

pages.title: Checkout & Payment Flow
pages.purpose: End-to-end checkout lifecycle: cart preparation, payment intent creation, provider-specific flows (Stripe, PayPal, Xendit, COD), finalization, and the cron-based recovery mechanism for stuck payments.

pages.title: Cart Management
pages.purpose: Cart API routes: attaching customers, merging guest carts, Medusa-bind on sign-in, cart abandonment beacon, and the CartSyncOnSignIn/WishlistSyncOnLogin lifecycle hooks.

pages.title: Storefront CMS & Product Components
pages.purpose: How the storefront renders CMS blocks (hero, rich_text, cta_row, featured_products), the CmsBlocksRenderer, CmsAnnouncementBar, CmsExperimentAssigner, product gallery, add-to-cart, and review form components.

pages.title: Admin Dashboard Application
pages.purpose: Overview of apps/admin — the Next.js 15 internal operations dashboard for staff. Links to child pages covering POS, CMS management, finance, and the admin API layer.

pages.title: Point of Sale (POS)
pages.purpose: The POS sub-system: commit-sale API route, shift management, POS policy enforcement via omnichannel-policy, the terminal-agent printer service, and the printer-core ESC/POS library.

pages.title: Admin CMS Management
pages.purpose: The admin-side CMS editors: pages, navigation, announcements, media, blog, categories, redirects, experiments, and forms — all backed by the platform-data CMS modules.

pages.title: Admin Finance & Payments
pages.purpose: Payment management routes (list, retry, mark-review), reconciliation dashboard, payment health endpoint, and the admin settings pages for payment providers and storefront configuration.

pages.title: Admin API Layer & Staff Auth
pages.purpose: The BFF (Backend for Frontend) pattern used in apps/admin: staff session validation, permission gates, correlation IDs, staff API response helpers, and the product lookup proxy.

pages.title: Medusa Commerce Engine
pages.purpose: Overview of apps/medusa — the Medusa 2.x headless commerce backend. Links to child pages covering payment modules, webhooks, subscribers, and configuration.

pages.title: Payment Provider Modules
pages.purpose: The four custom Medusa payment modules: Stripe Checkout, PayPal, Xendit, and COD. Covers service implementations, webhook handling, HMAC verification, and deduplication logic.

pages.title: Medusa Subscribers, Workflows & Logistics
pages.purpose: Event-driven subscribers (order placed, fulfillment, loyalty points, digital receipts, SMS), the J&T Express webhook integration, and the notify-order-shipped workflow.

pages.title: Shared Packages
pages.purpose: Overview of the internal workspace packages that are shared across apps. Links to child pages for platform-data, validation, SDK, database, and other utility packages.

pages.title: platform-data Package
pages.purpose: The @universal-music-store/platform-data package: Supabase client initialization, RBAC/identity, CMS modules, POS data, loyalty, compliance/DSAR, payment ledger, and the outbox pattern.

pages.title: database Package & Supabase Migrations
pages.purpose: The @universal-music-store/database package: Supabase schema, migration scripts, seed data, data-boundaries module, and the apply-sql tooling.

pages.title: validation, sdk, types & utility Packages
pages.purpose: The remaining shared packages: validation (Zod schemas for HTTP, CMS, compliance), sdk (env helpers, CMS helpers, analytics, feature flags, i18n, PH tax), types (shared domain types), rate-limits, resend-mail, omnichannel-policy, user-preferences, and the shared UI library.

pages.title: Auxiliary Services
pages.purpose: Overview of the two auxiliary runtime services: the Express API sidecar (apps/api) and the Terminal Agent (apps/terminal-agent). Links to child pages for each.

pages.title: Express API Sidecar (apps/api)
pages.purpose: The Node.js/Express sidecar service: health/readiness endpoints, compliance routes (DSAR export and erasure), internal API key auth, rate limiting, and deployment on Render.

pages.title: Terminal Agent (apps/terminal-agent)
pages.purpose: The local HTTP agent for POS hardware: ESC/POS receipt and label printing, cash drawer control, multi-adapter support (TCP, HTTP relay, QZ Tray, Epson ePOS, Star CloudPRNT), and Supabase device heartbeat.

pages.title: Testing Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Overview of the multi-tier testing strategy: unit tests, contract tests, E2E Playwright suites, stress/chaos tests, and visual regression (dogfood). Links to child pages for E2E and CI pipelines.

pages.title: E2E Test Suites & Playwright Configuration
pages.purpose: Playwright configuration, test categories (smoke, flows, dogfood, regressions), key specs (full-commerce-journey, PSP checkout flows, COD, storefront security/rate-limit), and the helpers/fixtures layer.

pages.title: CI/CD Pipelines & Release Gates
pages.purpose: GitHub Actions workflows: E2E release gate, full release gate, PSP sandbox connectivity checks, SBOM/license audit, security audit (Semgrep, Trivy, Gitleaks), and the DevContainer setup.

pages.title: Security & Compliance
pages.purpose: Overview of the security posture: secret scanning, boundary checks, OWASP controls, GDPR/privacy compliance, and the security program documentation.

pages.title: Security Boundaries & Audit Tooling
pages.purpose: The three automated security boundary checks (storefront client boundary, commerce migration boundary, admin API staff guard), the commit CLI security scanner, and the parallel-commit workflow.

pages.title: Privacy, Compliance & Data Governance
pages.purpose: GDPR/privacy compliance implementation: DSAR export, PII anonymization, data retention policies, the privacy-terms document, and the data-ownership ADR.

pages.title: Developer Tooling & Scripts
pages.purpose: Root-level developer scripts: dev startup orchestration, port management, cleanup utilities, the commit CLI, Bruno API collection generation, and the Cursor AI commands/skills system.
